capabilities: Create goal trees with subgoals and target dates
Build dashboards with streaks, progress bars, and charts
Pull numeric properties from notes into datasets
Embed live widgets in notes and Canvas
extras: Stores goals, schedules, watering history, datasets, and widget config as Markdown and YAML frontmatter in an Iter/ folder; requires Obsidian 1.14.5 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track long-term goals, milestones, and supporting habits with progress dashboards drawn from note data.
summary: Goal garden plugin that turns long-term goals into trees with subgoals, recurring habit watering, and dashboards built from note properties and widgets.
